title: Tax Preparation Workflow
description: A stage model for preparing and filing a tax return. The workflow advances a return through a defined sequence of stages - from gathering source documents to e-filing and sealing the year - and tracks per-stage status and review comments. This is a vocabulary for interoperability, not a tax-calculation engine.

taxYear.description: The tax year the return covers.

returnType.description: The kind of return being prepared. Firm-agnostic labels; jurisdiction-specific form numbers can be carried in formNumber.

currentStage.description: The stage the return is currently in.

stages.description: Per-stage progress records. The canonical stage order is defined by stageName; a workflow need not populate every stage but should not invent stage names.

reviewComments.description: Reviewer comments raised during preparation/review that may need preparer action before sign-off.

sealedAt.description: When the year was sealed (locked) after filing. Present only when currentStage is sealed.

stageName.description: Canonical, ordered tax-prep stages. Order: gathering -> in_preparation -> in_review -> awaiting_client_signature -> ready_to_file -> filed -> sealed.
